sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Ring ring, thank you for calling Fast Connect Internet.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: This is Alex speaking, how can I help you?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I'm calling because my current internet plan isn't cutting it anymore.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I work remotely and the connection keeps slowing down, especially during video calls.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I want to see about upgrading the higher speed plan, if possible.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Of course, Ashley, that can definitely be frustrating, especially if you're relying on it for work.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Let's take a look at your account and see if we have any options.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So you're saying you're with a competitor, you don't have an account with us yet?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: You know, I don't have an account with you guys.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, let's go ahead and create you an account here.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Let me just use your name and your email.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: What's a good email?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Ashley,

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, and do you know what plan you're currently on?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: yeah, so the plan that I am currently on is the 100Mbps plan.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: It's been a week, but the video conferences could, the cloud uploads and streaming is just, it can't keep up.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Yeah, it

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: makes sense.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So if you're going to switch over, I'd definitely recommend 250 to 500 MBPS plans.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Both would give you a much smoother performance and network connection for remote work, video calls, large file transfers.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Okay, what's the difference in pricing?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So the $250 plan is at $60 per month and then the $500 plan is right at $85 a month.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Both plans come with the same contract terms as your previous plan, a one -year agreement with no early termination fee if you stayed past the first month.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: All right, that sounds reasonable.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And would this require any equipment or can I just use my current model?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Great question.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Your current modem supports speeds up to 300, so it'll work for the $250 plan, but for the $500, we'd recommend our newer modem for optimal performance.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: I can help you set it up once the upgrade is processed.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Perfect.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: While we're on the phone, can you also give me some tips for troubleshooting my current modem?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Sometimes the connection drops even at the current speed.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Oh gosh, let me see.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Let me pull up your modem model here. So

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: first things you're going to want to do is to just make sure it's an essential location, not tucked behind any furniture.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Also, I'd unplug it for 30 seconds and then plug it back in.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: You wouldn't believe sometimes a simple reset often just clear some temporary issues that it may be having.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yeah, got it.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: That seems manageable.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Yeah, definitely.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Try that.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Let me know how it goes.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yeah.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, yeah.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Great.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So what would you like to go with the $250 or the $500?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Okay, let's just go ahead and do the 500.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I want to make sure I don't run into these issues anymore.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, I will go ahead and get that processed for you right now.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Your plan will update immediately and if you need the new modem, well, you'll need the new modem.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: I can get it shipped out to you today with instructions for setup.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yes, please.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I like a modem shipped as soon as possible.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Awesome.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: I will send you an email confirmation with the new plan details, shipping info for the modem, and then I'll include a step -by -step guide for installation.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Awesome.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And just to confirm, the contract terms are the same as before, right?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Yep, that's correct.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Just one year agreement, same as your current plan.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: After that, one month to month unless you decide to change on your own.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Okay, got it, Alec.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Just another question.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Actually, let me see.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Hold up.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: So I never mind.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I think I'm good.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yeah.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And you have my email to send the information and my address as well.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: So send me the new modem.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Yep, I got your email and your address for the new modem.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Whenever you get the new modem, you can go ahead and read the step -by -step instructions that I'll send you away.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: I will say with the old modem, we do offer a buyback program.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So if you want to ship us your old modem, we can maybe cut like $50 off your first bill.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: It's like a rebate program.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So that info will be included in the step -by -step guide as well.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Perfect.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: All right.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Thank you so much, Alec.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: You've been extremely helpful.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Yep, not an issue at all.

sentences.text: Thank you.
